title: Mythical Creatures
description: A fantasy bestiary search site featuring dragons, griffins, phoenixes and more. Includes a complete SN site with faceted search, content documents and a React SPA template.
author: Viglet

title: Space Missions
description: Explore historic and fictional space missions with semantic search. Features mission data, crew information and launch details with a beautiful search interface.
author: Viglet

title: Vinyl Records
description: A music catalog search site for vinyl records. Browse albums by artist, genre, year and label. Complete with content index and a retro-styled React search template.
author: Viglet

title: WKND (AEM)
description: Adobe Experience Manager connector sample based on the WKND reference site. Ingests pages, assets and metadata from AEM into a complete SN site with a React SPA template.
author: Viglet

title: Celestial Gallery (Assets)
description: Assets connector sample showing astrophotography indexing. Demonstrates file ingestion, metadata extraction and thumbnail generation, with a React SPA template.
author: Viglet

title: Retro Arcade (Database)
description: JDBC connector sample indexing a retro arcade game catalog. Shows SQL mapping, incremental delta and custom attributes, with a React SPA template.
author: Viglet

title: Wikipedia (Web Crawler)
description: Web crawler connector sample ingesting Wikipedia articles. Demonstrates URL filtering, content extraction and link following, with a React SPA template.
author: Viglet
